lines.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance.
Make haste, O God, to deliver me!
Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
May those who seek my life
may those who wish me harm
rejoice and be glad in You;
may those who love Your salvation always say,
But I am poor and needy;
You are my help and my deliverer;

pictures.scene: Angelo Jank, Parforcejagd - a red-coated huntsman driving his horse over a fence with two riders galloping hard behind him, the headlong urgency of the psalm's opening cry, Make haste, O God, to deliver me
pictures.name: pd_jank_parforcejagd

pictures.scene: Jan Victors, Jozef legt de bakker en de schenker hun dromen uit - Joseph in the prison counting out the meaning of the dreams to the chained cupbearer and the baker, a man forgotten in a pit crying for the LORD to hurry and help him
pictures.name: pd_victors_jozef_legt_de_dromen_uit

pictures.scene: Jacques Courtois, Battle Scene with Turkish Cavalry - a turbaned rider swinging his lance at an armoured cuirassier who fires back point-blank, those who seek a man's life brought to shame and confusion
pictures.name: pd_courtois_slagveld_met_turkse_ruiterij

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Mocking of Christ - Christ blindfolded and crowned with thorns while a head spits at Him and hands strike Him with rods, those who jeer Aha, aha driven back and humiliated
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_bespotting_van_christus

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Georg Waldmuller, Am Fronleichnamsmorgen - village girls in white dresses with rose garlands laughing together in the clear morning sun, all who seek the LORD turning from shame to gladness
pictures.name: pd_waldmuller_am_fronleichnamsmorgen

pictures.scene: Konstantin Makovsky, A Boyar Wedding Feast - a white-bearded elder raising a great gold goblet high over the crowded table, those who love God's salvation rejoicing and saying it aloud
pictures.name: pd_makovsky_boyarenbruiloft

pictures.scene: Ludwig Knaus, Ein Madchen auf dem Feld - a small peasant girl alone in a wide flowering meadow gathering herbs into her apron, Let God be magnified, yet I am poor and needy
pictures.name: pd_knaus_meisje_op_het_veld

pictures.scene: Mattheus Ignatius van Bree, De prins van Oranje bezoekt de slachtoffers van de watersnood - the prince standing in the crowded orphanage hall as a weeping woman is brought to him, help hurrying to the ruined and the deliverer come in person
pictures.name: pd_van_bree_bezoek_aan_de_slachtoffers_van_de_watersnood

pictures.scene: Theodore Gudin, Lighthouse - the lighthouse burning steady on its rock while the sea breaks white over it and a small boat of men labours in the swell below, O LORD, do not delay
pictures.name: pd_gudin_vuurtoren
